I have created an authentic, high-fidelity recreation of the official **BUGATTI** homepage design study (`1280x720` desktop format) reflecting the public design language and verified assets:

1. **Brand Identity & Typography**:
   - Integrated the official Bugatti web fonts (`BUGATTI Display`, `BUGATTI Monospace`, and `BUGATTI Text Regular`) with pure `#000` deep black luxury background and architectural whitespace rhythm.

2. **First Viewport & Video Hero (720px)**:
   - Autoplaying, looping, muted, playsinline video teaser background with custom vignette overlay.
   - Minimalist header positioned at `x56 y52` with the accessible two-line `MENU` button, centered BUGATTI wordmark, and `STORE` with bag icon at the right.
   - White inverted hero mark featuring the Solitaire Destrier monogram, uppercase monospace tagline *"A STORY OF PROPORTION AND CRAFTSMANSHIP."*, and the pill action *"DISCOVER PURE BEAUTY"* linking to the official destination.
   - Lower-right Atelier careers toast with authentic photo, dismiss button, and verified link.

3. **Complete Editorial Sections**:
   - **La Maison BUGATTI**: 60px display headline, 1184px container, 3-column editorial grid showcasing customer gatherings, Type 35 heritage, and Molsheim Atelier craft.
   - **Programme Solitaire & Sur Mesure**: Full-width promotional blocks featuring the vector Solitaire insignia, official campaign copy, and Sur Mesure customization header.
   - **Embrace the BUGATTI lifestyle**: Side-by-side showcase of the HONMA and C SEED collaborations.
   - **Our Hyper Sports Cars**: 6-card hypercar matrix (Tourbillon, W16 Mistral, Bolide, Chiron, Divo, Centodieci) with authentic imagery, uppercase title treatments, and tags.
   - **BUGATTI Live**: Cookie/consent boundary for third-party media feeds accompanied by Ettore Bugatti's script signature motto (*"If comparable it is no longer Bugatti"*).

4. **Interactive Modal & Accessibility**:
   - Interactive full-screen navigation modal with `Escape` key capture, focus management, and `prefers-reduced-motion` compliance.
   - Comprehensive footer with the four official pillar directories, English/Français switcher, social links, and copyright disclosure.

designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

The design system embodies the apex of automotive engineering, bespoke craftsmanship, and French haute horlogerie aesthetics for mobile web. It caters to collectors, automotive purists, and high-net-worth clients who expect digital experiences to match the precision of hand-milled titanium, polished carbon fiber, and uncompromised speed.

The visual aesthetic synthesizes **Ultra-Luxury Minimalism** with **Haute Horlogerie & Aerospace Engineering**:
- **Canvas:** Pure unadulterated deep black (`#000000`), evoking private showroom viewings, bespoke nocturnal unveilings, and zero-ambient-light museum spaces.
- **Tone:** Unapologetic authority, quiet confidence, mechanical precision, and supreme refinement.
- **Tactile Sensibility:** Flat yet profound; relying on hairline architectural divisions, negative space as an active luxury material, precision technical notations, and sharp monolithic layouts. Zero playful rounding, zero skeuomorphic gradients, and zero standard consumer-app components.

## Layout & Spacing

Space is treated as a structural luxury asset. Mobile screens reject cluttered UI patterns, favoring expansive vertical breath that mimics an art gallery monograph:

- **Grid Model:** 4-column fluid mobile grid anchored by a minimum `margin` of `1.5rem` (24px) up to `2rem` (32px) on larger handheld displays, with a structural `gutter` of `1.25rem` (20px).
- **Rhythm & Cadence:** Generous section spacing (`space-xl`, 72px) separates distinct narrative chapters (e.g., Aerodynamics, W16/V16 Powertrain, Bespoke Configurator).
- **Alignment:** Rigid left-aligned typography counterpointed by right-aligned telemetry readouts along hair-thin axis lines.
- **Edge bleed:** Vehicle imagery, technical schematics, and interactive 3D viewports span full-bleed edge-to-edge (`margin: 0`), anchored immediately above or below by hairline structural headers.

## Elevation & Depth

This design system completely disavows drop shadows, blur radiuses, ambient halos, and skeuomorphic embossing.

- **Hair-Thin Monochrome Outlines:** Spatial hierarchy and structural groupings are demarcated entirely via 1px crisp borders (`#1F1F1F` to `#2E2E2E`).
- **Planar Transitions:** Overlays (such as full-screen technical specifications, material selectors, or navigation menus) enter via razor-sharp, zero-blur modal planes of pure `#000000` sliding seamlessly along the vertical axis.
- **Mechanical Contrast:** Depth is perceived through luminance contrast between intense pure white `#FFFFFF` typography against the void of the `#000000` ground, rather than volumetric surface elevation.

## Components

### Action Links & Calls to Action
Standard pill-shaped and rounded rectangle buttons are strictly forbidden.
- **Primary CTA:** An uppercase monospaced text link (`JetBrains Mono`, `interactive-action`) in `#FFFFFF`, featuring a continuous 1px bottom border spaced `6px` below the text.
- **Hover/Active State:** The underline expands from `0%` to `100%` width or transitions to an inverted high-contrast block (pure `#FFFFFF` fill with pure `#000000` typography, zero radius).
- **Directional Indication:** An ultra-fine arrow glyph (`→` or `↗`) positioned with a `12px` gap, shifting `4px` outward upon interaction.

### Cards & Grouping
Generic boxed cards with rounded borders, drop shadows, or grey background fills are banned.
- **Vehicle & Feature Showcases:** Framed using open, hair-thin monochrome horizontal rules (`border-top: 1px solid #222222; border-bottom: 1px solid #222222;`). Elements sit directly on the pure black canvas.
- **Telemetry Grid:** Key specs (e.g., `0-100 KM/H`, `TOP SPEED`, `POWER`) are arranged in an open matrix separated strictly by 1px vertical and horizontal hair-thin lines, featuring large geometric numerals with uppercase monospaced sub-labels directly underneath.

### Technical Tags & Status Indicators
- **Chassis / Spec Tags:** Rendered in `technical-tag` (`JetBrains Mono`, uppercase, tracked `0.22em`), framed by an explicit 1px monochrome border (`#333333`) with a zero-radius footprint, zero background fill, and minimal internal padding (`4px 8px`).

### Lists & Specifications Tables
- **Spec Rows:** Minimalist data rows spanning 100% width. Left-hand label in `#A0A0A0` (`body-sm`), right-hand value in `#FFFFFF` (`body-sm` or `JetBrains Mono`). 
- **Divider:** Separated by a single, crisp 1px rule in `#1A1A1A`.

### Form Fields & Inquiries
- **Bespoke Commission Inputs:** Single-line border at the base (`border-bottom: 1px solid #444444; border-top/left/right: none; background: transparent;`).
- **Input Text:** Set in `Geist` or `JetBrains Mono` in `#FFFFFF`. Floating label in `#A0A0A0` that transitions to `technical-tag` sizing above the baseline when active.
- **Focus State:** Border-bottom transitions sharply to `#FFFFFF`.

### Checkboxes & Selectors
- **Selection Units:** Miniature `14px x 14px` square boxes with `0px` border-radius and a `1px solid #555555` border.
- **Selected State:** Filled with a centered `6px x 6px` solid white square; no rounded checkmarks or ornate check icons.

## Brand & Style

The design system embodies the apex of automotive engineering, bespoke craftsmanship, and French haute horlogerie aesthetics for mobile web. It caters to collectors, automotive purists, and high-net-worth clients who expect digital experiences to match the precision of hand-milled titanium, polished carbon fiber, and uncompromised speed.

The visual aesthetic synthesizes **Ultra-Luxury Minimalism** with **Haute Horlogerie & Aerospace Engineering**:
- **Canvas:** Pure unadulterated deep black (`#000000`), evoking private showroom viewings, bespoke nocturnal unveilings, and zero-ambient-light museum spaces.
- **Tone:** Unapologetic authority, quiet confidence, mechanical precision, and supreme refinement.
- **Tactile Sensibility:** Flat yet profound; relying on hairline architectural divisions, negative space as an active luxury material, precision technical notations, and sharp monolithic layouts. Zero playful rounding, zero skeuomorphic gradients, and zero standard consumer-app components.

## Colors

The palette is strictly architectural, high-contrast, and restrained, allowing vehicle silhouettes, carbon textures, and engineering specs to command ultimate focus without chromatic interference.

- **Canvas & Backdrops:** Absolute Black (`#000000`). No dark gray substitutes for primary viewports or body backgrounds.
- **Primary Typographic & Interactive Focus:** Crisp White (`#FFFFFF`). Delivers piercing contrast and razor-sharp typographic legibility.
- **Secondary & Technical Typography:** Muted Precision Grey (`#A0A0A0`). Used for technical vehicle specs (kW, BHP, Nm, RPM), monospaced serial tracking, and metadata headers.
- **Borders & Dividers:** Subdued Hairline Grey (`#222222` to `#333333`), rendered strictly as 1px fine architectural divisions.
- **Surface Elevation:** Subtle Off-Black (`#080808` to `#0D0D0D`) strictly reserved for bespoke technical trays and drawer bottoms where separation from the pure black canvas is structurally mandatory.

## Typography

Typography reflects the tension between timeless coachbuilt grandeur and surgical digital mechanics:

- **Display & Headline Hierarchy (`Bodoni Moda`):** Delivers dramatic editorial scale and neoclassical luxury. Used for model nomenclature, vehicle philosophies, and high-impact chapter headers. Never set in all-caps for full sentences; title or sentence case emphasizes the extreme contrast of the letterforms.
- **Body & Continuous Reading (`Geist`):** Delivers pristine legibility and a contemporary, non-distracting voice for vehicle descriptions, bespoke configuration narratives, and historical records.
- **Technical Readouts, Subheadings & Action Tags (`JetBrains Mono`):** Strictly all-caps with generous tracking (`0.18em` to `0.25em`). Conveys precision telemetry, VIN/chassis identification, engine displacement figures, and interactive invitations.

## Layout & Spacing

Space is treated as a structural luxury asset. Mobile screens reject cluttered UI patterns, favoring expansive vertical breath that mimics an art gallery monograph:

- **Grid Model:** 4-column fluid mobile grid anchored by a minimum `margin` of `1.5rem` (24px) up to `2rem` (32px) on larger handheld displays, with a structural `gutter` of `1.25rem` (20px).
- **Rhythm & Cadence:** Generous section spacing (`space-xl`, 72px) separates distinct narrative chapters (e.g., Aerodynamics, W16/V16 Powertrain, Bespoke Configurator).
- **Alignment:** Rigid left-aligned typography counterpointed by right-aligned telemetry readouts along hair-thin axis lines.
- **Edge bleed:** Vehicle imagery, technical schematics, and interactive 3D viewports span full-bleed edge-to-edge (`margin: 0`), anchored immediately above or below by hairline structural headers.

## Elevation & Depth

This design system completely disavows drop shadows, blur radiuses, ambient halos, and skeuomorphic embossing.

- **Hair-Thin Monochrome Outlines:** Spatial hierarchy and structural groupings are demarcated entirely via 1px crisp borders (`#1F1F1F` to `#2E2E2E`).
- **Planar Transitions:** Overlays (such as full-screen technical specifications, material selectors, or navigation menus) enter via razor-sharp, zero-blur modal planes of pure `#000000` sliding seamlessly along the vertical axis.
- **Mechanical Contrast:** Depth is perceived through luminance contrast between intense pure white `#FFFFFF` typography against the void of the `#000000` ground, rather than volumetric surface elevation.

## Shapes

The shape philosophy is strictly **Sharp (`roundedness: 0`)**. 

- All containers, viewports, borders, overlays, inputs, and interactive surfaces have a border-radius of `0px`.
- Rounded corners, circular badges, and pill containers are strictly prohibited, preserving an uncompromising, architectural precision akin to cut diamonds, milled carbon monocoques, and geometric technical drawings.

## Components

### Action Links & Calls to Action
Standard pill-shaped and rounded rectangle buttons are strictly forbidden.
- **Primary CTA:** An uppercase monospaced text link (`JetBrains Mono`, `interactive-action`) in `#FFFFFF`, featuring a continuous 1px bottom border spaced `6px` below the text.
- **Hover/Active State:** The underline expands from `0%` to `100%` width or transitions to an inverted high-contrast block (pure `#FFFFFF` fill with pure `#000000` typography, zero radius).
- **Directional Indication:** An ultra-fine arrow glyph (`→` or `↗`) positioned with a `12px` gap, shifting `4px` outward upon interaction.

### Cards & Grouping
Generic boxed cards with rounded borders, drop shadows, or grey background fills are banned.
- **Vehicle & Feature Showcases:** Framed using open, hair-thin monochrome horizontal rules (`border-top: 1px solid #222222; border-bottom: 1px solid #222222;`). Elements sit directly on the pure black canvas.
- **Telemetry Grid:** Key specs (e.g., `0-100 KM/H`, `TOP SPEED`, `POWER`) are arranged in an open matrix separated strictly by 1px vertical and horizontal hair-thin lines, featuring large geometric numerals with uppercase monospaced sub-labels directly underneath.

### Technical Tags & Status Indicators
- **Chassis / Spec Tags:** Rendered in `technical-tag` (`JetBrains Mono`, uppercase, tracked `0.22em`), framed by an explicit 1px monochrome border (`#333333`) with a zero-radius footprint, zero background fill, and minimal internal padding (`4px 8px`).

### Lists & Specifications Tables
- **Spec Rows:** Minimalist data rows spanning 100% width. Left-hand label in `#A0A0A0` (`body-sm`), right-hand value in `#FFFFFF` (`body-sm` or `JetBrains Mono`). 
- **Divider:** Separated by a single, crisp 1px rule in `#1A1A1A`.

### Form Fields & Inquiries
- **Bespoke Commission Inputs:** Single-line border at the base (`border-bottom: 1px solid #444444; border-top/left/right: none; background: transparent;`).
- **Input Text:** Set in `Geist` or `JetBrains Mono` in `#FFFFFF`. Floating label in `#A0A0A0` that transitions to `technical-tag` sizing above the baseline when active.
- **Focus State:** Border-bottom transitions sharply to `#FFFFFF`.

### Checkboxes & Selectors
- **Selection Units:** Miniature `14px x 14px` square boxes with `0px` border-radius and a `1px solid #555555` border.
- **Selected State:** Filled with a centered `6px x 6px` solid white square; no rounded checkmarks or ornate check icons.
